subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: When more than one assurance pass is required, the review path shall keep the passes mutually blind until each has produced a revision-bound terminal result, union their surviving findings, and derive one aggregate result using the most restrictive pass verdict; any proposal change shall stale every pass and require the full assurance-pass set on the new exact revision before acceptance.
rationale: independent scrutiny is defeated if one pass can influence another, a favorable verdict can be cherry-picked, or one stale pass can certify a changed proposal
fit_criterion: fixtures prove pass-order invariance, union all surviving findings, make any non-accepting or absent pass prevent aggregate acceptance, reject output leakage and favorable-verdict selection, and force every required pass to rerun after head change
